name: incident.io
description: incident.io lets agents read incidents, alerts, on-call schedules, and catalog entries, and update incidents in the signed-in organization. An admin must turn on the MCP server in Settings, and each user signs in through the browser.

prompts.text: List the open incidents and their severity.
Who is on call for the platform team right now?
Draft a summary of yesterday's database incident for the postmortem.

apps.description: Incidents, alerts, on-call schedules, and catalog, over incident.io's MCP server with browser sign-in.
